relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: Giès studied design, painting, and engraving at the Académie de la Grande Chaumière starting at the age of 13.

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: From 1972 to 1975, he studied at the Beaux Arts de Paris.

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: He earned a doctoral degree in art history from Paris-Sorbonne University, concentrating on the Chinese language and civilization.

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: He taught at Paris-Sorbonne University from 1974 to 1998

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: and subsequently at the École du Louvre from 1998 to 2008.

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.role: conservator of Chinese and Central Asian art
relations.evidence: In 1980, he became a conservator of Chinese and Central Asian art at the Guimet Museum.

relations.subject: Jacques Giès
relations.evidence: He served as President of the Guimet Museum from 2008 to 2011.
